verdict.rationale: Fern Agent lets users describe changes in natural language and have them applied to the docs repository. Those changes can be prompted from Slack or run on a schedule, opening PRs. Fern's private MCP server also lets a coding agent read sites, deployments and reader activity on request. Natural-language operation is documented only for docs content edits and read-only lookups, not for operating the product as a whole. missing for 10: natural-language control of SDK generation, publishing and configuration; evidence of the full surface Fern Agent can act on; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
